description: This file implements traversal and filtering of objects (commits, trees, blobs, tags) in a git repository, including functions for processing individual objects, handling tree contents, and managing traversal state.

classes.name: traversal_context
classes.description: Struct holding traversal state, including pointers to revision info, show functions, filters, and depth counter.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Calls the show_commit function with the current commit if the show_commit callback is set.

methods.name: void show_object(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct object * object,const char * name)
methods.description: Calls the show_object function with the given object and name if the show_object callback is set, and skips if the object is from a pack that has been unpacked.

methods.name: void process_blob(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct blob * blob,struct strbuf * path,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a blob object, applying filters and possibly displaying it.

methods.name: void process_tree_contents(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Iterates over the entries of a tree, processing subtrees and blobs recursively.

methods.name: void process_tree(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tree object, applies filters, shows the object, and processes its contents unless skipped.

methods.name: void process_tag(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tag * tag,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tag object, applying filters and displaying if needed.

methods.name: void mark_edge_parents_uninteresting(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge)
methods.description: Marks the parent commits of a given commit as uninteresting and displays them if edge hints are enabled.

methods.name: void add_edge_parents(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Marks parent trees as uninteresting for a given commit and adds their oids to a set.

methods.name: void mark_edges_uninteresting(struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,int sparse)
methods.description: Marks commits and their parents as uninteresting, with optional sparse processing and edge hints.

methods.name: void add_pending_tree(struct rev_info * revs,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Adds a tree object to the list of objects pending traversal.

methods.name: void traverse_non_commits(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Processes the pending objects that are not commits (tags, trees, blobs).

methods.name: void do_traverse(struct traversal_context * ctx)
methods.description: Main traversal loop that processes commits and their associated trees, including non-commit objects.

methods.name: void traverse_commit_list_filtered(struct rev_info * revs,show_commit_fn show_commit,show_object_fn show_object,void * show_data,struct oidset * omitted)
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes traversal context, runs the traversal, and applies filters to the processed objects.

ctags.signature: (struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,struct oidset * set)

ctags.signature: (struct traversal_context * ctx,struct blob * blob,struct strbuf * path,const char * name)
